trajectory.instruction: Remove all songs from my Spotify song library and playlists that were released in or before 2021 year.

steps.reasoning: All required public API signatures must be inspected before any task API is called.
steps.action_code:
required_api_refs = [
    ("supervisor", "show_profile"),
    ("supervisor", "show_account_passwords"),
    ("supervisor", "complete_task"),
    ("spotify", "login"),
    ("spotify", "show_song_library"),
    ("spotify", "show_playlist_library"),
    ("spotify", "show_playlist"),
    ("spotify", "show_song"),
    ("spotify", "remove_song_from_library"),
    ("spotify", "remove_song_from_playlist"),
]
api_documentation = {}
for app_name, api_name in required_api_refs:
    api_documentation[(app_name, api_name)] = apis.api_docs.show_api_doc(app_name=app_name, api_name=api_name)

steps.reasoning: The documented Supervisor APIs provide the account email and Spotify password needed to obtain an access token without hardcoding or printing credentials.
steps.action_code:
supervisor_profile = apis.supervisor.show_profile()
account_passwords = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
spotify_account = next(account for account in account_passwords if account["account_name"].strip().lower() == "spotify")
spotify_password = spotify_account["password"]
spotify_session = apis.spotify.login(username=supervisor_profile["email"], password=spotify_password)
spotify_access_token = spotify_session["access_token"]

steps.reasoning: The complete song and playlist libraries, plus each playlist's contents, are needed to identify every location covered by the instruction.
Library and playlist records do not expose release dates, so every distinct referenced song must be inspected through the documented song-detail API.
The release-date records are now available, so qualifying song IDs and their exact library or playlist locations can be derived and reviewed before the first mutation batch.
steps.action_code:
eligible_song_ids = {song_id for song_id, detail in song_details_by_id.items() if int(detail["release_date"][:4]) <= 2021}
reviewed_library_song_ids = tuple(sorted(song_library_song_ids & eligible_song_ids))
target_playlist_song_pairs = tuple(sorted({(playlist_id, song["id"]) for playlist_id, playlist in playlist_details_by_id.items() for song in playlist["songs"] if song["id"] in eligible_song_ids}))
print({"reviewed_song_library_removals": len(reviewed_library_song_ids), "candidate_playlist_removals": len(target_playlist_song_pairs)})
